# Minimal Light attribution

The homepage adapts the profile-sidebar and content-column structure of
[Minimal Light](https://github.com/yaoyao-liu/minimal-light) by Yaoyao Liu.
The responsive layout and stylesheet have been customized for this site.
The template's sample content, tracking code, external fonts, and icon dependencies
are not included.
